subject: Short-term response SLA carveout & cross-region on-call routing for migration surge
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@fastlane.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: ops-team@fastlane.ai
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: temporary P1/P2 SLA carveout during migration window

Hi Evelyn,

Quick note from our side — we’re kicking off a cross-region model migration next week that will spike inference traffic overnight for about 72 hours (expected windows: 2026-12-11 00:00 PST through 2026-12-14 06:00 PST). Our SREs expect a higher rate of P2 incidents (non-blocking but user-facing latency regressions) between 00:00–06:00 PST.

We want to request a short-term, documented carveout for P2 response windows overnight (proposed: extend from 4h to 8h) for the migration window only. We still need strict P1 coverage and 1-hour response for anything impacting availability.

Attached is our migration runbook and a brief traffic forecast. We can align on escalation contacts and are open to a temporary routing change (route non-critical alerts to a dedicated on-call pool).

Can you confirm if Redwood can:
- Temporarily extend P2 window overnight for the stated 72 hours
- Guarantee P1 1-hour response unchanged
- Provide a named escalation contact and brief run-of-show for the on-call rotation

We’d like to finalize by EOD tomorrow so our teams can proceed.

Thanks,
Marta
Marta Ruiz
Head of Platform Reliability, FastlaneAI

Attachment: migration-runbook.pdf (pdf, 1.2MB stub)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Request: temporary P1/P2 SLA carveout during migration window

Team — forwarding FastlaneAI’s request. Key asks: overnight P2 extension to 8h for 72h, keep P1 at 1h, named escalation contact and delegated on-call pool.

Initial constraints and notes:
- We can’t change contractual SLAs without CS/legal sign-off; for short windows we typically do a documented carveout + operational plan + a small credit if needed.
- We should preserve P1 routing to our primary on-call (no changes). P2 routing can be diverted to a dedicated surge pool and to a regional fallback to avoid latency spikes.
- Need to confirm on-call capacity and whether Marcus/Ben can accept short-term rotation adjustments.

Please propose a concrete carveout plan (timing, routing rules, on-call roster, escalation contacts) and I’ll draft the external note to Fastlane.

Thanks — Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Director, Customer Success (Sales)
Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposed-oncall-rotation.csv (stub)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 11:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: temporary P1/P2 SLA carveout during migration window

Agree we can operationalize a short-term carveout with these guardrails: 
- Scope: 2026-12-11 00:00 PST → 2026-12-14 06:00 PST (72 hours)
- P1: unchanged (1-hour response), primary on-call stays intact, immediate pager escalation to the P1 rota
- P2 (temporary): overnight extension to 8 hours between 00:00–06:00 PST only; daytime remains 4h
- Routing: route P2 alerts during the carveout to a dedicated surge pool (two engineers per night) with cross-region fallback to EU pool if SFO capacity is constrained.
- Escalation path: first responder → surge lead (Ben Carter) → Marcus Lin (backstop pager) → CS leadership (Evelyn)
- Compensation: propose a one-off service credit clause if we miss agreed P1/P2 targets during the window; legal to approve language.

Operational tasks I’ll create: SUP-3421 (Jira) to track on-call changes, runbook readout scheduled for 2026-12-11 08:00 PST with Fastlane SREs. Ben — can you confirm you can cover surge lead nights 12/11–12/14? Irene — can you confirm the routing rules and add the policy to our routing config?

I’ll draft the external note for Evelyn to send once we have Ben/Irene ack and Legal signoff.

—Marcus
Senior Engineering Manager, Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@fastlane.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, ops-team@fastlane.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Short-term response SLA carveout & cross-region on-call routing for migration surge

Hi Marta — thanks for the extra detail and runbook. We can accommodate your requested carveout under the following mutually agreed terms: 

1) Window and scope: 2026-12-11 00:00 PST → 2026-12-14 06:00 PST (72 hours).
2) P1: Redwood will maintain 1-hour response and unchanged escalation paths.
3) P2: During the overnight window (00:00–06:00 PST) only, P2 response window will be extended to 8 hours. Daytime P2 remains 4 hours.
4) On-call & routing: Redwood will route P2 alerts during the window to a dedicated surge pool (Ben Carter as surge lead). Cross-region fallback to EU pool is configured if SFO capacity falls below threshold.
5) Escalation: responder → surge lead (Ben Carter) → Marcus Lin (backstop pager) → Evelyn Hart (CS escalation).
6) Credits & audit: If Redwood fails agreed P1/P2 targets during the window, FastlaneAI will be eligible for a one-time service credit; legal will finalize wording in a short addendum.
7) Signoff: please acknowledge by replying to this thread and we’ll countersign via DocuSign.

Ben — confirmed for surge lead nights 12/11–12/14. Irene — routing change deployed to staging; prod push scheduled 12/11 23:30 PST. Marcus — SUP-3421 created and assigned.

Marta — if this captures your ask, reply with approval and we’ll send the DocuSign.

Best,
Evelyn
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Attachment: signed-carveout-docusign.pdf (pending, will attach post-signature)

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@fastlane.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 17:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RE: Short-term response SLA carveout & cross-region on-call routing for migration surge

Thanks Evelyn — this looks good to us. We approve the terms and will complete the DocuSign. Appreciate the quick turnaround and the detailed escalation path.

—Marta

(Inline reply: Thanks Ben/Marcus/Irene — we’ll be on standby during the window and will join the 12/11 08:00 readout.)
